verdict.rationale: A state filing portal could plausibly offer API or programmatic access for automation, so this axis applies. The evidence shows no headless or CI-capable interface. The probes found both the front door and the ORION filing portal behind Akamai and Incapsula bot walls, closing the transaction surface to keyless automated agents.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
